name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ウマ娘 プリティーダービー トウカイテイオー
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Umamusume: Pretty Derby Tokai Teio

ja: 『ウマ娘プリティーダービー』トウカイテイオーがFigure-rise Standardで走りだす‼
■前傾姿勢で走る、ウマ娘ならではの疾走ポーズを再現。
スカートは側面がスリット構造になっており、跳ね上げるように動かすことが可能。
重なったパーツが目隠しになり、シルエットを崩さずに前傾姿勢で走る姿が決まる。
■特徴的なテイオーステップも再現可能。
■弾ける笑顔と、元気いっぱいの動きも魅力的に演出。
■表情の異なる３種の顔パーツが付属。笑顔の瞳は「タンポ印刷」で再現。
他の２種は水転写式デカールを採用。
■１パーツ単位で構造を追求することにより、“勝負服”や頭部などが組み立てるだけでカラフルに仕上がる。
■靴裏の蹄鉄はシールで再現。靴の前後をパーツ分けすることで、地面を蹴る姿もしなやかに表現。
■頭部は、動きを付けられる耳やリボン、風になびいて抑揚のあるポニーテールを演出。
■左右で色の異なるハンドパーツが付属。右手は表情のある平手と合わせて合計６種類をセット。
■背中に支柱を接続し、クリア成形の台座でボディを保持。走る姿を演出する。
en: “Uma Musume Pretty Derby” Tokai Teio starts running with Figure-rise Standard!!
• Reproduces the sprinting pose unique to Uma Musume, which runs with a forward leaning position.
The skirt has a slit structure on the side and can be flipped up.
The overlapping parts act as a blindfold, allowing you to lean forward while running without compromising your silhouette.
• The characteristic Teio step can also be reproduced.
• Her bright smile and energetic movements are also attractive.
• Three types of face parts with different expressions are included. The smiling eyes are reproduced with "tampo printing".
The other two types use water transfer decals.
• By pursuing the structure of each part, "competition clothes" and heads can be made colorful just by assembling them.
• The horseshoes on the soles are reproduced with Seal. By separating the front and back parts of the shoe, it is possible to express the way he kicks the ground.
• The head features movable ears and ribbons, and a ponytail that flutters in the wind.
• Hand parts with different colors on the left and right are included. There are a total of 6 types of right hands, including a palm with expressions.
• Connect the post to the back and hold the body with a clear molded base. Produce the appearance of running.
